title: Statistical Convergence of Transformer Encoder-Accelerated Robust Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.23775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Obtaining the optimal action-value function in Markov decision processes is computationally intensive in large state--action spaces. In this study, we present statistically rigorous convergence results for a robust reinforcement learning algorithm warm-started by a transformer-based action-value function prediction, where natural language prompts encode task specifications. Our framework adopts the R-contamination model to characterize uncertainty in the state transition kernel, and employs conformal prediction to certify convergence via trajectory-level nonconformity scores constructed from the contracting Bellman residual. The resulting conformal quantile bounds the gap between the running and optimal action-value functions simultaneously over all iterations, thereby yielding a pre-certified stopping rule that requires little knowledge of the true transition kernel. Numerical case studies on perturbed maze environments of varying size

translated_title: Transformer编码器加速的鲁棒强化学习的统计收敛性
translated_abstract: 在马尔可夫决策过程中，在大规模状态-动作空间中获取最优动作值函数的计算开销十分巨大。在本研究中，我们针对一种鲁棒强化学习算法给出了统计上严格的收敛性结果，该算法由基于Transformer的动作值函数预测进行热启动，其中自然语言提示用于编码任务规范。我们的框架采用R污染模型来刻画状态转移核中的不确定性，并通过由收缩Bellman残差构造的轨迹级非一致性分数，利用保形预测来认证收敛性。由此得到的保形分位数在所有迭代过程中同时界定了当前动作值函数与最优动作值函数之间的差距，从而产生了一种预认证的停止规则，该规则几乎无需了解真实转移核的知识。论文还在不同规模的扰动迷宫环境中进行了数值案例研究。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个由基于Transformer的动作值函数预测热启动的鲁棒强化学习算法，结合R污染模型与保形预测，给出了统计上严格的收敛性保证以及几乎无需真实转移核知识的预认证停止规则。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes statistically rigorous convergence guarantees for a robust reinforcement learning algorithm warm-started by transformer-based action-value function prediction, combining the R-contamination model with conformal prediction to yield a pre-certified stopping rule requiring little knowledge of the true transition kernel.
